parent_objective: design bounded no-PPO pair-group objective update protocol
blocked_by: M1343 selects update-design route but no bounded update protocol exists
supersedes: direct pair-group objective update without design

public_gates: M1344 must not update actor weights
M1344 must not use private holdout
M1344 must preserve actor input contract
M1344 must design bounded update acceptance gates
M1344 must check branch cadence before implementation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs bounded no-PPO update protocol for the M1343 pair-group conflict route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design routes directly to implementation despite cadence trigger
stop if design permits pair-specific weights
fallback_plan: if design passes and cadence permits, route to bounded implementation
if cadence requires synthesis, route to branch synthesis before implementation
if trainable scope is ambiguous, route to scope audit
if group objective is underdetermined, route to projection or corpus repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1343 admits one bounded update design before cadence synthesis

admission_evidence: PPO and actor update remain blocked
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1344 designs update protocol over zero-context source-current group diagnostics and cannot claim closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design before/after checks for grouped correct-history versus wrong-history residuals
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If update design cannot preserve both condition rows, route to synthesis or projection repair before implementation.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A bounded no-PPO pair-group objective-update protocol can be designed without running an update, and it can specify whether branch synthesis is required before implementation.
success_criteria: design specifies group-min and condition-balance losses
design specifies exact before/after row and group gates
design specifies forbidden parameter mutation checks
design specifies branch cadence route before implementation
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, checkpoint mutation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design routes directly to PPO or actor update
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, checkpoint mutation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1344 passes as a design milestone if it defines a bounded no-PPO pair-group update protocol and the required cadence route without running training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or actor-input expansion.
